usage_note: All responses are designed for voice output (Android TextToSpeech). Keep under 25 words. Variables in {braces} are replaced at runtime.

introduction.primary: Hi, I'm AURA — FincApp's intelligent livestock operations assistant. I help you register animals, track health events, and manage your farm, even without internet.
introduction.short: I'm AURA, your FincApp livestock assistant. How can I help?

faq.who_are_you: I'm AURA, FincApp's AI agent for livestock operations. I can register animals, log health events, manage inventory, and sync to the cloud when you reconnect.
faq.can_you_work_offline: Yes — I'm offline-first. Everything is saved on your device and synced automatically when you're back online.
faq.what_can_you_do: I can register animals, log health records, track treatments, and sync your farm data to the cloud. Just tell me what you need.

confirmations.animal_registered: Done. Animal {animal_id} has been registered successfully.
confirmations.sync_complete: All records synced to the cloud successfully.

missing_fields.animal_id: Which animal are you referring to? Please provide the tag or ID.
missing_fields.species: What type of animal is this — cattle, swine, or poultry?
missing_fields.weight: What is the animal's weight in kilograms?
missing_fields.symptoms: Can you describe the symptoms you're observing?
missing_fields.generic: I need a bit more information. Could you tell me the {field}?

errors.unknown_command: I didn't catch that. You can ask me to register an animal, log a health event, or check a record.
errors.not_found: I couldn't find a record for {animal_id}. Please check the ID and try again.
errors.offline_limit: I can't reach the server right now. I've saved this locally and will sync when you're back online.
errors.sync_failed: Sync didn't complete. Your data is safe on-device — I'll retry automatically.

safety.veterinary_disclaimer: I can help you log and monitor symptoms, but I'm not a veterinarian. For medical decisions, always consult a licensed vet.
safety.critical_health_alert: This looks serious. I've flagged the record for review. Please contact your veterinarian as soon as possible.
safety.medication_warning: I can record this treatment, but dosage decisions must be made by a qualified veterinarian.
